flipToBack.prose: Flip if owner controls at least 3 Dantooine sites each with a Rebel contributing to control, AND opponent controls zero Dantooine locations. Both checks use SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE.

children.req: control-with: owner controls >=3 locations matching filter, with cardFilter (Rebel) cards among the controlling presence
control: opponent controls >=1 location matching filter

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if opponent controls at least 2 Dantooine locations (count becomes 3 when legacy game-text modification LEGACY__MORE_DANGEROUS_THAN_YOU_REALIZE__REQUIRES_THREE_SITES_TO_FLIP_BACK is active). SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE.

children.req: control: opponent controls >=N Dantooine locations, N=2 normally, N=3 if legacy game-text modification is active

requirementSemantics: flipToBack leaf 1: CONTROL-WITH semantics (GameConditions.controlsWith = player controls at least count locations matching locationFilter with at least one card matching cardFilter there): 3x Dantooine site controlled with Rebel. NOT mere occupation; control required, and a Rebel must be among the presence.
flipToBack leaf 2: CONTROL semantics negated: opponent must control ZERO Dantooine locations (any Dantooine location, sites AND system).

flipToFront leaf: CONTROL semantics: opponent controls >=2 (or 3 under legacy mod) Dantooine locations. Location scope is Dantooine_location (system included), broader than the front's site-only owner requirement.
All control checks pass SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, so cards excluded from battle still count for control.
typedIdentities: Filters.Dantooine_location (opponent constraint on front; opponent flip-back locations on back)
Filters.or(Filters.site, Filters.and(Filters.non_unique, Filters.Rebel)) (per-turn Reserve Deck deploy to Title.Dantooine)
Filters.Imperial + Filters.Dantooine_location (deploy cost modifier, both sides)
Filters.and(CardSubtype.SYSTEM, Filters.title(Title.Dantooine, true)) (blown-away place-out-of-play, both sides)
Back only: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.squadron); Filters.wherePresent(self, yourSquadrons)
setupAndPullRoutes: START OF GAME (front, required): deploy Dantooine system from Reserve Deck: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.and(Filters.Dantooine_system), true, false) [Card7_135.java:50-59]

FRONT, once per owner's deploy phase: deploy from Reserve Deck to system Title.Dantooine one card matching Filters.or(Filters.site, Filters.and(Filters.non_unique, Filters.Rebel)); reshuffle. Gated by GameConditions.isOnceDuringYourPhase(Phase.DEPLOY) + canDeployCardFromReserveDeck. keyCharacterFilter is null: flip law requires Filters.Rebel as the controlling actor (controlsWith cardFilter); Rebel is not covered anywhere in the profile.
Opponent-side constraint (opponent controls ZERO Filters.Dantooine_location) is not represented in any profile field.
Flip count threshold (3 sites) is not represented; flipGateCardIds and requiredCardsOnTable are empty and weights are empty.
objectiveNamedLocations does cover Filters.Dantooine_system/site/location filters, but only as untyped named locations with no flip-gate role.
